finding.expected: Modify only src/product_intelligence/cli.py and tests/product_intelligence/test_product_intelligence_cli.py as needed. Make discover reject repeated --query, repeated --cdp-endpoint, and repeated --shortlist-size with argparse-style exit code 2. Preserve ordered repeated --platform as the sole repeatable discover control and preserve all other TASK-146 behavior and authorities unchanged. Add focused regression tests for these duplicate-option cases.
finding.issue: The discover parser accepts repeated occurrences of single-value Human controls --query, --cdp-endpoint, and --shortlist-size because argparse's default store action silently keeps the last supplied value. TASK-146 requires exactly one --query and exactly one --cdp-endpoint, allows --shortlist-size only as one optional control, and reserves repetition only for --platform. Silent overwrite therefore violates the exact Human-input and fail-closed boundary in AC2.
